title: olearia viscosa
intro: Olearia viscosa, commonly known as sticky tree, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Olearia viscosa include its ability to act as an antiseptic, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful for wound healing and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
